name: Doppio Malto
note: Proposed rating: none. The doppiomalto.com footer attributes the brand to FoodBrand S.p.A.; Tottus in Pari (18 Jan 2023) calls founder Giovanni Porcu sole shareholder, president and CEO of the Doppio Malto chain. A registro-imprese filing would tie FoodBrand S.p.A. itself to Porcu. Front-of-shirt since 2025/26, under a four-year deal to 2027/28.
